preheader: Anthropic plans $64.35B debut, Jensen Huang comeback push, and McKinsey's AI banking stats.

lead.headline: Anthropic's Planned $64.35 Billion Market Debut Faces Wall Street Scrutiny
lead.body: AI startup Anthropic is heading toward a public listing with a proposed $64.35 billion share sale. Wall Street investors are examining the valuation after mixed results from recent tech debuts, where only four out of seven major tech IPOs trade above their offer price after one year.
lead.why: If you want to work in finance or tech, watching how markets price cash-burning AI startups shows how investors balance growth against high infrastructure costs.

figures.label: Recent tech IPOs trading above offer price

stories.headline: Networking Equipment Glitch Triggers Nationwide Flight Ground Stop
stories.body: A single router in Arkansas flooded the aviation network with data, causing a nationwide FAA ground stop. The outage stranded passengers across the country just weeks before Thanksgiving travel.
stories.why: Operations management classes at Merage often focus on single points of failure, showing how one broken piece of hardware can stall an entire system.

stories.headline: Boeing-Lockheed Rocket Launch Fails, Destroying 40 Amazon Satellites
stories.body: United Launch Alliance suffered its first total mission failure when its Vulcan rocket malfunctioned ten minutes after liftoff. The failure resulted in the loss of all 40 Amazon Leo internet satellites on board.
stories.why: Joint ventures come with high shared operational risks, which is key context if you analyze corporate strategy or aerospace supply chains.

stories.headline: Supporters Campaign for Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to Return
stories.body: Following Jensen Huang's resignation, an open letter signed by over 158,000 people and a Silicon Valley war room are pushing for his reinstatement. Huang is reportedly in discussions about a potential comeback while board talks continue.
stories.why: Corporate governance battles offer a real-time lesson on how executive leadership and founder influence shape public tech companies.

stories.headline: Apple Launches Research App to Study AI Use in Personal Health
stories.body: Apple debuted its Health AI Usage Study app to gather data on how people ask everyday medical questions. Participants can submit health queries and rate the accuracy of AI answers inside the app.
stories.why: Big tech firms are testing consumer trust before shipping deep AI features, which matters if you want to product-manage consumer software.

stories.headline: McKinsey Report Highlights Fast Returns for AI in Banking
stories.body: A new McKinsey report shows banks using autonomous AI software can recover their investment in 10 months. The study projects these tools will deliver 2.9 times returns over three years despite security and data readiness hurdles.
stories.why: Consultants frequently advise corporate clients on technology ROI, so knowing these payback metrics gives you solid talking points for case interviews.

stories.headline: Big Four Firms Expand M&A Advisory Teams to Match Indian Deal Boom
stories.body: Deloitte, PwC, EY, and KPMG are building out their transaction advisory teams in India. The expansion covers services from deal sourcing and due diligence to post-acquisition work.
stories.why: If you are eyeing advisory roles, transaction services remain a strong hiring track inside top accounting and consulting firms.

stories.headline: UCI Researchers Map 8 Million Deep Brain Cells
stories.body: University of California, Irvine scientists mapped roughly 8 million cells in deep regions of the human brain. The team identified 60 distinct cell types to help advance research on neurological disorders.

stories.headline: Mirra Andreeva Wins WTA Finals Without Dropping a Set
stories.body: Nineteen-year-old Mirra Andreeva beat Elina Svitolina 7-5, 6-3 in the WTA Finals championship match. The victory completed an undefeated 5-0 run at the tournament without losing a single set.

term.name: Agentic AI
term.definition: Software systems powered by artificial intelligence that can independently make decisions and carry out multi-step tasks without constant human guidance. In business, companies deploy these agents to automate complex workflows like customer service or banking operations.

serve.headline: Bharat Semi raised $24 million seed funding to build AI image sensors
serve.body: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi secured $24 million in an all-equity seed round led by Info Edge Group and South Park Commons. The pre-revenue company builds programmable sensors with built-in AI for defense, automotive, and drone applications.
